chat_messages.text: The upload test times out on CI but passes locally. Where do I look?

content.thinking: A local pass with a CI timeout usually means a fixed sleep. I should ask for the fixture that waits.

content.text: Start with tests/upload_spec.rs: a hard-coded sleep that is shorter than the CI disk flush is the usual cause.

chat_messages.text: Right, it was a 200ms sleep. Replaced it with a wait-until helper.
How do I list files bigger than 100 MB under D:\data on Windows?

```powershell
Get-ChildItem D:\data -Recurse -File | Where-Object Length -gt 100MB
```
